description: React component for managing and rendering metric controls in a data exploration UI, including handling saved metrics, adhoc metrics, and user interactions.

classes.name: MetricsControl
classes.description: React functional component for metric selection and management in a data visualization context.

methods.name: getOptionsForSavedMetrics
methods.description: Filters saved metrics based on current metric values and current metric.

methods.name: isDictionaryForAdhocMetric
methods.description: Checks if a value is a dictionary representing an adhoc metric.

methods.name: coerceAdhocMetrics
methods.description: Converts various representations of metrics into AdhocMetric instances or raw values.

methods.name: getMetricsMatchingCurrentDataset
methods.description: Filters metrics to match the current dataset columns and saved metrics.
